objectives: Decode taught words ending in lk.
Recognise that l is silent in the taught pronunciation.
Distinguish walk, talk, chalk, and stalk using their other sounds.
Reread and self-correct when a sound is added or omitted.
concepts: In taught final-lk words, l is silent.
Other vowel and consonant sounds identify the whole word.

definitions.definition: Use letter-sound knowledge to read a word.

workedExamples.solution: Read the word naturally and do not add a separate /l/ sound.
Talk ends with /k/; tall does not.
